note: Initial quantity keys for comparison. Extend only through a contract PR. A Finding with a numeric value must use one of these keys and exactly this unit.

flame_spread_rate.description: Rate of flame front advance over a solid fuel surface.

extinction_oxygen_mole_fraction.description: Lowest oxygen mole fraction at which a flame was sustained, as reported.

ignition_delay.description: Time from ignition energy onset to sustained flame, as defined by the source.

flame_length.description: Flame length as defined by the source.

flame_temperature.description: Flame or gas temperature as reported by the source.
